source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Follows the difficult transmitted comparison rather than silently emending it to an accusation against priests.
Follows the first-person exchange in the pinned text rather than substituting an ancient alternative subject.
Preserves the sin/sin-offering double sense rather than resolving the exploitative image into a paraphrase.
Reads keep at the preceding clause as abandoning observance; notes the possible linkage with the next verse.
Keeps all three agents and renders heart as understanding in this context.
Makes the male referents explicit and avoids claiming certainty that qedeshot denotes cultic prostitution.
Retains the heifer/lamb contrast; marks the final clause as a contextual question with declarative alternative noted.
Renders the difficult repeated love/give phrase cautiously while retaining the rulers' shameful desire.
